llm_judge_details.justification: The topology covers most core VNFs and includes gNB/UE, but omits PCF, so completeness is slightly short. All VNF types, interfaces, and connections follow 3GPP 23.501, earning full correctness. Resource requests are modest; for a true eMBB deployment higher CPU/memory would be expected, leading to a moderate score. The slice definition (SST=1) matches eMBB and is advertised by relevant VNFs, giving perfect slice alignment. SLA targets (10 ms latency, 1 Gbps throughput, 99.9% availability) are reasonable for eMBB, though throughput could be higher, resulting in a good but not perfect rating.
